highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 includes a Windows HarfBuzz build that passes the BinSkim BA2007 check.

bullets.detail: The bundled libHarfBuzzSharp.dll now passes BA2007 by scoping truncation-warning suppression to vendored source. Existing unrelated BinSkim warnings are unchanged.

harfbuzz_summary: The bundled Windows native library now passes BinSkim BA2007 through source-scoped warning suppression. Exported symbols and shaping behavior are unchanged; unrelated pre-existing BinSkim warnings remain.

v4.151.4.headline: SkiaSharp 4.151.4 includes a Windows HarfBuzz build that passes the BinSkim BA2007 check.
